d1.why: The grader conflated the virus-like V-POD-M+H2O2 arm with the flat POD-M+H2O2 arm, which are distinct materials in this paper (Figure 1: POD-M is the uncoated octahedral mimic, V-POD-M adds the spiky silica shell); the whole-figure image and the crops' OCR confirm F7b's legend, F7c's photograph rows and F7d's section rows list only Control, H2O2, V-POD-M+H2O2 and Vancomycin, with no POD-M+H2O2 arm anywhere in Figure 7, even though the F7 linked text says a POD-M+H2O2 group was set up and describes its day-16 scab, so the node and its panel citations are right as written.
